chapters.summary: Paul encourages Timothy to be strong and courageous, to hold fast to the pure gospel, and bears witness to the sufferings he has endured for it.
keyPoints: Paul thanks God and remembers Timothy's genuine faith, urging him to stir up the gift of God that is in him.
Paul emphasizes that the gospel is not a matter of cowardice but the power of God, and calls Timothy to share in suffering for the gospel according to God's power.
Paul holds himself up as an example: though he suffers affliction, he is not ashamed, for he is persuaded that the Lord is able to keep what has been committed to him.
chapters.application: On the path of faith, we too will meet challenges and pressures, but God has not given us a spirit of fear, but of power, love, and a sound mind. Stand firm in the Lord, and never be ashamed of the gospel.

chapters.summary: Paul urges Timothy to be strong in the grace that is in Christ Jesus, to be a workman who need not be ashamed, and warns him to guard against worldly chatter and those who depart from the truth.
keyPoints: Be strong, and be a good soldier of Christ Jesus, not entangling yourself with the affairs of this life.
Rightly divide the word of truth, and be a workman who need not be ashamed.
Avoid worldly chatter and foolish disputes, and seek to recover those taken captive by the devil.
chapters.application: In your life of faith, be strong and courageous, devote yourself to studying God's word, pursue righteousness, faith, love, and peace with a pure heart, and gently guide those who have gone astray.

chapters.summary: Paul warns of the perils of the last days, urges Timothy to hold fast to the truth, and points to the authority and benefit of Scripture.
keyPoints: In the last days perilous times will come, when people will be lovers of themselves, lovers of money, and unholy.
Avoid false teachers, for they are corrupt in mind and have departed from the faith, though their folly will in the end be exposed.
Timothy must follow Paul's example and hold firmly to the inspiration and teaching of Scripture.
themes: The Perils of the Last Days
chapters.application: In a chaotic age, let Scripture be your mirror. Hold fast to pure faith, keep far from false teaching, and live out a godly life.

chapters.summary: As he nears the end of his life, Paul charges Timothy to preach faithfully, declares that he has fought the good fight, and speaks of his own loneliness alongside the presence of the Lord.
keyPoints: Paul solemnly charges Timothy before God to preach the word, and to persist in season and out of season.
Paul declares that his departure is at hand - he has fought the good fight and finished the course.
Paul mentions that his fellow workers forsook him, but the Lord stood by him and strengthened him to preach.
chapters.application: Whatever your circumstances, remain faithful to your calling. When you face the end of life, may you be able to say with confidence that you have kept the faith, for the Lord will be with you and will give you the crown.
